query: Initialize a new Python project called order-sync in ~/work/order-sync. It's an ETL service that pulls orders from an API.
expected_behavior: Gathers or defaults inputs: name order-sync, package order_sync, Python 3.12, app layout, line length 140
Runs scripts/init_project.py without --apply first and shows the plan to the user before applying

Result has pyproject.toml with uv and ruff config, Makefile with install, lint, typecheck, lint-yaml, unit-tests, scripts/ci.sh, configs/.pre-commit-config.yaml, .github/workflows/ci.yaml, AGENTS.md, .env.example and tests/ mirroring src/
After applying, installs every skill under skills/python/ except python-project-init, plus code-review from skills/review/, with /scaffold-repo claude (dry run first)
Runs make install, make lint and make unit-tests in the new project and reports the results

query: Bootstrap a shared library called vireox-utils that other repos will install as a wheel.
expected_behavior: Chooses the lib layout: src/vireox_utils/ package with a hatchling build-system and a py.typed marker, not a bare src/ import root
Tests import vireox_utils, not src
Creates only .github/workflows/ci.yaml as a workflow

query: Run the project init in ~/work/legacy where pyproject.toml and a Makefile already exist.
expected_behavior: Dry run reports the existing files as conflicts and writes nothing
Does not overwrite or delete the files and does not invent a force option
Asks the user how to proceed, for example a different directory or merging by hand

query: Set up a new Python project my-tool. I don't want any agent skills installed, just the project.
expected_behavior: Creates the project with the init script and verifies it
Skips the /scaffold-repo step
Still creates AGENTS.md

query: Init a Python project in ~/work/billing, and give it the team's python skills.
expected_behavior: Lists skills/python/ and picks every skill except python-project-init instead of a remembered list, and adds code-review
Runs /scaffold-repo claude <dest> with those names, dry run shown before apply
Does not copy skill files by hand
Mentions the manifest pins the hub commit

query: Add a new module for parsing invoices to my existing Python project.
expected_behavior: Does not use python-project-init because the project already exists
Follows the existing project structure instead of scaffolding a new one

query: After init, make lint fails in the new project.
expected_behavior: Reads the lint output and fixes the cause in the generated files instead of disabling the rule
Re-runs make lint, make typecheck, make lint-yaml and make unit-tests until all pass and reports what changed
